result.description:
An exceptional opportunity for a  full-time General Practitioner  is available at a busy,  private-billing medical center  on the stunning NSW North Coast. Due to a large patient base needing additional support, the practice is looking for a GP to join their team and enjoy a fantastic beach-side lifestyle. 

 The center is a modern, well-equipped facility with 14 consultation rooms, excellent treatment facilities, and two procedure rooms. It is a supportive and friendly environment, home to a team of 11 highly respected doctors. The practice operates from Monday to Saturday, with a strong patient base and a variety of services offered, including women's health, audiology, mental health, and travel vaccinations. The center also provides  experienced CDM/CVC nurse support  and an  efficient administrative team  to manage practice logistics, allowing the practitioner to focus entirely on patient care. For added convenience, the center is co-located with an Australian Skin Cancer Clinic and has on-site pathology services. 

 This role offers significant  clinical autonomy  and  flexible working arrangements . The practice encourages and supports a wide range of  special interests  and provides opportunities for a scope of practice in areas like skin, aesthetics, and occupational medicine. The center is committed to professional growth, with a  RACGP partnership  that simplifies CPD requirements, offering free in-house opportunities and discounted registration for industry events. For those interested in mentoring,  GP Registrar Supervisor opportunities  are also available. 

 Located in  Coffs Harbour , a  DPA-approved location , the area offers an unbeatable coastal lifestyle. This Mid North Coast city provides a relaxed atmosphere with over 30 beaches, national parks, and a vibrant community. With a growing job market in healthcare and a lower cost of living than major cities, it is an appealing choice for a professional seeking to combine a rewarding career with an exceptional quality of life.  Work-life balance is prioritised through  flexible working arrangements , with both full-time and part-time hours available to suit individual needs. The location itself provides unparalleled  lifestyle benefits , situated just minutes from pristine beaches and only 20 minutes from the iconic Byron Bay. An established, doctor-owned, and accredited mixed-billing medical practice in Rockingham, Western Australia, is seeking a qualified General Practitioner to join its patient-focused team. Located approximately 45 minutes from the Perth CBD, this modern clinic operates within a Distribution Priority Area (DPA), making it an eligible and attractive opportunity for GPs under moratorium. The practice offers a vibrant clinical environment equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, advanced technology, and onsite pathology, ensuring a seamless and efficient diagnostic workflow for both doctors and patients. 

 Practitioners are supported by a dedicated, multidisciplinary team comprising experienced administrative staff and skilled nursing professionals who actively assist with care plans and Chronic Disease Management (CDM). This comprehensive support structure ensures that GPs can focus primarily on patient care while maintaining full clinical autonomy. The practice caters to a diverse demographic, offering ample scope for incoming doctors to pursue and develop special interest opportunities. For those interested in medical education, the practice environment offers a supportive platform for future supervisor opportunities to mentor registrars and medical students. 

 The role prioritizes a healthy work-life balance, featuring flexible working arrangements with a weekday schedule from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and absolutely no callouts. Financially, the position offers a high percentage of billings alongside a negotiable initial guaranteed payment for the first three months. Continuous Professional Development (CPD) is highly encouraged and supported to facilitate ongoing career growth. Beyond the clinic walls, the Rockingham location delivers exceptional lifestyle benefits, combining the relaxed, coastal charm of Western Australia’s beaches with convenient free onsite parking and easy commuting access to the metropolitan amenities of Perth. A fantastic opportunity has arisen for an experienced, Vocationally Registered (VR) General Practitioner to join a thriving, inclusive, and professional medical practice on the beautiful Central Coast. Situated just five minutes off the freeway, the location offers the perfect balance of convenience and lifestyle, making it an easy commute from Sydney while providing an idyllic, family-friendly environment to live and work. The practice operates with a deep commitment to care, fostering a warm and collaborative culture where both patients and practitioners feel genuinely supported. 

 Practitioners will thrive in a state-of-the-art, comprehensive care environment. The facility is a true multidisciplinary hub, offering on-site pathology, general X-ray, physiotherapy, chiropractic services, podiatry, psychology, therapeutic massage, and a pharmacy. This mixed-billing clinic grants doctors full clinical autonomy to practice medicine their own way, while also unlocking excellent opportunities to pursue or develop special interests in areas such as skin cancer medicine. 

 The support structure within the practice is second to none, designed to ensure a seamless and efficient workday. A dedicated, highly skilled nursing team is available during all opening hours to assist with clinical procedures, chronic disease management (CDM), and care plans. Complementing this is a stellar administrative and reception team that efficiently handles patient bookings, billing, and all correspondence in a timely manner, allowing GPs to focus entirely on patient care. 

 Incoming doctors will join a collegiate team of highly professional, supportive peers. The clinic offers strong mentorship and professional development support, with a respected Medical Director available as a trusted sounding board and mentor. For those interested in teaching, there are also excellent opportunities to step into supervisor roles. With highly flexible working arrangements tailored to support a healthy work-life balance, this position is ideal for a GP looking to elevate their career in a truly supportive, turnkey practice environment. result.description:
Our Client – Ten Acres Farm Pty Ltd trading as Ten Acres is seeking passionate and experienced full-time Bakers and Pastry Cooks to join their dynamic team in Ninderry, QLD. Offering a competitive salary package of AUD 75–85K per annum plus superannuation, negotiable for the right candidate, this is a standout opportunity for professionals eager to advance their careers in a modern, thriving bakery environment.

Ten Acres is celebrated across the Sunshine Coast for its artisanal breads, pastries, and baked goods, crafted with premium local ingredients and a commitment to excellence. The bakery has built its reputation on quality, innovation, and consistency, making it a destination for locals and visitors alike.

As part of the Ten Acres team, you will:
- Collaborate with talented bakers and pastry chefs.
- Showcase your craft in a bakery known for its creativity and high standards.
- Gain professional growth and career progression in a supportive, forward-thinking environment.

For motivated bakers ready to contribute to one of the Sunshine Coast’s most recognised bakery brands, this role is the perfect next step. Join Ten Acres and be part of shaping the region’s bakery culture.

You will be required to do the following duties:
- Prepare, mix, weigh and bake breads, pastries, artisan loaves, and specialty baked goods in line with Ten Acres recipes and production schedules
- Monitor Ten Acres stocks for baking ingredients such as flour, sugar, etc. and make appropriate orders within budget for management
- Check the quality of ingredients and maintain accurate stock levels for Ten Acres flour, perishables, and baking supplies
- Operate and maintain commercial Ten Acres baking equipment, including ovens, mixers, proofers, and related machinery
- Adjust temperatures, fermentation processes, and production settings to ensure consistent Ten Acres product quality
- Follow strict food safety, hygiene, and WHS standards across all stages of Ten Acres production
- Monitor dough development, proofing, and baking times to meet both Ten Acres quality and volume requirements
- Assist in planning daily Ten Acres production volumes, product ranges, and seasonal offerings
- Decorate and finish Ten Acres baked goods where required
- Glazing Ten Acres buns and pastries, and decorating cakes with cream and icing, as required
- Maintain accurate records of Ten Acres ingredient usage, batch production, wastage, and quality checks
- Work collaboratively with the broader Ten Acres bakery and retail team to ensure smooth daily operations
- Ensure all Ten Acres food and other items are stored properly
- Keeping accurate Ten Acres records
- Operating a variety of Ten Acres kitchen equipment

To be considered for this role, you should:
- Be willing to relocate if you are interstate or in other cities.
- Be available on both days at weekends and be able to work split shifts.
- Preferably hold a certificate in culinary arts, pastry-making, baking or a relevant field
- Qualified Baker/ Pastry Cook with 2-3 years of experience
- Ability to work in a team.
- Excellent communication skills.

How to join the team:
Please submit an online application to join our diverse, compassionate, and dedicated team for a rewarding career. Only successful applicants will be contacted.
Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or have the capacity to work in Australia permanently. A temporary visa holder may only be employed if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.

A popular community medical center in northern Melbourne is seeking a compassionate and dedicated  General Practitioner  to join its friendly and cohesive team. This is an immediate opportunity for a GP to take over an existing and growing patient base and be busy from day one. 

  Practice Environment and Support  

 The practice is a modern, purpose-built facility with 11 consult rooms, a 3-bay treatment room, and a dedicated procedure room, all designed to support a high standard of patient care. Located within a bustling shopping complex with high foot traffic and ample parking, the center offers excellent visibility and accessibility. The incoming GP will receive extensive support from a full-time clinical team, including nurses for both the treatment room and Chronic Disease Management (CDM), as well as an experienced administrative team that handles all day-to-day operations. This mixed-billing center is open Monday through Friday, ensuring a healthy work-life balance for all staff. 

  Professional Growth and Autonomy  

 This role offers a high degree of clinical autonomy, allowing doctors to manage their patient caseload and practice style. The practice fosters a collegial environment where all GPs are focused on positive patient outcomes. There are numerous opportunities for professional growth and development, including support for Continuing Professional Development (CPD), with free in-house events and discounted industry registrations. For GPs interested in mentoring, there are supervisor opportunities with expanded support. The practice also provides support for special interests with scope of practice in areas such as skin, aesthetics, and occupational medicine. 

  Lifestyle and Flexibility  

 The position provides flexible working arrangements to accommodate a healthy work-life balance. Located just 40 minutes north of Melbourne, the area offers the perfect blend of suburban tranquility and easy access to the city's amenities. This is a chance to build a rewarding, long-term career in a supportive environment while enjoying the vibrant lifestyle benefits of the surrounding community.   Apply Now

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Transform lives, every single day

Do you want a career that means more?

At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen.

We're a well-respected not-for-profit that's been serving society's most vulnerable for over 170 years. Each year, we achieve life-changing outcomes for more than 40,000 people who rely on our person-centred support. And now, we're extending our reach and impact even further.

As a Case Manager - Family Preservation & Restoration, you'll play a vital role in helping vulnerable children remain safely with their families or supporting their safe restoration home. Working within our Community & Mission team, you'll deliver intensive, evidence-based case management that empowers families to build safer, healthier and more stable environments for their children.

Be welcomed into a compassionate, respectful and purpose-driven community where we don't just talk about values-we live them.

Your opportunity

As our Case Manager - Family Preservation & Restoration, you'll provide case management to children and families g in Anglicare's Families Together and Permanency Support Programs. Using the evidence-based Parents Under Pressure (PuP) framework, you'll work collaboratively with families to strengthen parenting capacity, improve child safety and support long-term family wellbeing.

You'll build strong relationships with children, parents, carers, the Department of Communities and Justice (DCJ) and other service providers to deliver coordinated, strengths-based support that creates lasting outcomes for families.

With integrity and resilience, you will:

Deliver intensive case management and therapeutic support to vulnerable children and families.

Complete comprehensive assessments, case plans and interventions using the Parents Under Pressure (PuP) framework.

Conduct regular home visits to assess safety, wellbeing and family progress.

Build strong partnerships with DCJ, carers and community agencies.

Maintain high-quality case documentation and contribute to continuous improvement.

What you'll bring

You are a compassionate and resilient case management professional who thrives in complex environments and is passionate about improving outcomes for vulnerable children and families.

You will also need:

Degree qualification in Social Work, Psychology, Welfare, Community Services, Social Science or a related discipline.

Experience working with vulnerable children, young people and families.

Demonstrated assessment, counselling and case management skills.

Knowledge of child protection legislation and family preservation practices.

Current NSW Driver Licence.

Current Working With Children Check.

Ideally, you will also have:

Two or more years' experience within child protection, family preservation or out-of-home care.

Experience working with DCJ.

Willingness to undertake accreditation as a Parents Under Pressure (PuP) Therapist.

Strong stakeholder engagement and report writing skills.

Why Anglicare?

We provide meaningful opportunities and choice, both for the individuals and communities we support and the dedicated people here who make it happen.

Pay less tax with salary packaging.

Up to $2,650 tax free for meals and entertainment.

Accredited Parents Under Pressure (PuP) Therapist training.

Ongoing professional development and clinical supervision.

Exclusive discounts with hundreds of retailers.

Employee Assistance Program and Fitness Passport.

We're many services, with one purpose, to meet people where they are and walk with them.

Are you ready for a career that means more?

To apply for this role, please click the Apply button and submit your r sum and cover letter.

All applicants will receive a response.

Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the customers and communities we support. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders, abilities and cultural backgrounds.
